description:
From fz-t93.26's paper. After M1+S1+P, these still differ between fifo and lifo and are not traced: 00761, 00763, 00765 (an atom-union column is wider in one order), 01174, 00569, 01793 (list(A) | list(B) in one order, list(A|B) in the other), 01800 (a recursive list folded or unfolded); and the distiller's dump still differs in 2 places (an Enum.reduce closure-union row split differently, one callable(...) line). They look like the row-dominance and fold family; unproven. Paper first. Done when the plan is byte-identical under every order on the distiller and the matrix (fz-t93.26's original criterion). Evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/t93_26/r3/.

Census 2026-11-24 on develop fd3bfb964 (after fz-t93.26), every fixture under fifo and lifo (fz-t93.28's paper, scratch t93_28/census_base): 14 differ. 01574 is fz-t93.28 and 00795/00796 are fz-t93.27. The other 11 differ in type structure (union width, recursive list unfolding, atom sets): 00569, 00761, 00763, 00765, 01174, 01793, 01800 (already above), and also 00758, 00760, 00762, 01160, which this ticket did not list before. About 107 fixtures panic when compiled in-process by the census harness and are not covered.

2026-11-24 seeded orders (JSON's spike knob: fifo, lifo, xorshift seeds 1-8; develop de4ef6a3b; scratch ebbfffd8-…/scratchpad/mue25/probes/p9/): 01353 has 2 plans (seed:3, seed:5; lifo agrees with fifo, so the fifo/lifo census misses it). The one differing line is element evidence: fifo keeps `:array | :ok | empty_list()` / `list(:array | :ok | empty_list())` where seed:3 has `:array | :ok` / `list(:array | :ok)` (01353_plan.diff). Fifo/lifo under-reports: this ticket's census must use seeded orders too.

comments.text: Its PR adds 01353 to ORDER_FREE_PLANS as its failing-first test; once fz-t93.32 lands, the order test also runs seeds, and 01353 splits only under seeds 3 and 5.

title: The remaining order-dependent plans are traced
